rules.description: Applicant must have paid PAYE tax in the current tax year
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have paid PAYE income tax this tax year to claim a refund

rules.description: Applicant must have left employment during the tax year
rules.reason_if_failed: This form is for people who have stopped working. If you're still employed, check your tax code with your employer instead.

rules.description: Applicant must not be returning to work before the end of the tax year (April 5th)
rules.reason_if_failed: If you're returning to work before April 5th, your new employer will adjust your tax code and you'll be refunded automatically

rules.description: Applicant should have a P45 from their last employer
rules.reason_if_failed: You'll need your P45 form to complete this application. Contact your previous employer if you don't have it.

rules.description: Applicant must be a UK taxpayer or have UK tax obligations
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for UK taxpayers only

rules.description: Other income must not exceed personal allowance (£12,570 for 2024/25)
rules.reason_if_failed: Your other income may affect your refund eligibility. You may need to complete a Self Assessment instead.

edge_cases.description: Applicant had multiple jobs in the same tax year
edge_cases.action: Request all P45 forms. Calculate cumulative PAYE and allowances. May require manual assessment.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is receiving Jobseeker's Allowance or other taxable benefits
edge_cases.action: Taxable benefits count as income and may reduce or eliminate refund. Route to specialist assessment.

edge_cases.description: Applicant was on an emergency tax code (BR, 0T, etc.)
edge_cases.action: Emergency tax codes often lead to overpayment. Likely eligible but verify cumulative position.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has left the UK permanently during the tax year
edge_cases.action: Different rules apply for non-residents. Route to P85 (leaving UK) process instead.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has self-employment income alongside PAYE
edge_cases.action: Self-employment income complicates the refund calculation. May need Self Assessment instead.
